test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT part of India's 12 forts nominated for UNESCO World Heritage under the title 'Maratha Military Landscapes of India' for 2024-25?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Karnala Fort**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karnala Fort** is not included in the list of India’s **12 forts nominated for UNESCO World Heritage** under the title **'Maratha Military Landscapes of India'** for the year 2024-25.
 
• This fort is located in the **Raigad district** of Maharashtra and is a popular **trekking destination**.
 
• Karnala Fort is known for its historical importance during the **Maratha and Mughal era**, but it is not part of the specific UNESCO nomination under the Maratha Military Landscape theme.
 
• The fort is situated within the **Karnala Bird Sanctuary**, which is a protected area and a hub for biodiversity.
 
• While it is significant regionally, it does not meet the **specific criteria or thematic focus** of the nominated forts under the Maratha Military Landscapes proposal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Raigad Fort**__

 __
 
• **Raigad Fort** is one of the most iconic forts of the Maratha Empire and was the capital of **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.**
 
• It is located in the **Sahyadri mountain range** in Maharashtra.
 
• Raigad Fort is included in the UNESCO nomination due to its **historical significance**, **architectural marvels**, and importance in Maratha history.
 
 
 
• **Salher Fort**__
 __
 
• **Salher** is one of the highest forts in Maharashtra, located in the **Nashik district**.
 
• It is significant for being the site of the **Battle of Salher**, one of the most famous battles fought by the Marathas against the Mughals.
 
• This fort is part of the UNESCO nomination due to its **historical military importance**.
 
 
 
• **Rajgad Fort**__
 
 
• **Rajgad** was the **first capital** of the Maratha Empire under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
 
• It is renowned for its **strategic location**, architectural brilliance, and its role in Maratha history.
 
• This fort is included in the UNESCO nomination for its **historic and cultural value.**
